content: Connect your own provider API key to run a model on it. Your key takes precedence: requests to that model go to the provider directly rather than through OpenRouter. The provider bills you for the tokens used, and only a service fee on that amount is charged to your wallet.

comment.text: Description at the top of the API keys (BYOK) section of the AI settings page, shown when no service-fee percentage is known. Explains that a customer's own provider key bypasses OpenRouter and that only a service fee is charged to the DocSpace wallet; OpenRouter is a product name and stays untranslated.
